material_finding.description: For a two-leg Local Factor hedge, min(p_fill_a,p_fill_b) is the Frechet upper bound on joint completion, not a conservative estimator of joint completion. It can remain positive when true same-window completion is zero, and it omits the economic loss of one-leg partial fills that must be aborted or unwound.
material_finding.interpretation: Identical marginal fill probabilities can imply negative or positive pair EV depending on same-window dependence and partial-fill unwind economics. A positive edge times min-marginal utility is therefore insufficient evidence for executable LF pair alpha.

fresh_live_context.measurement_caveat: The current standard v6_live_smoke_once.sh records the public tape before relation intents and runs the multi-leg broker only once, so this exact smoke is not a forward same-window completion sample for the two resting Graph/RV baskets.

use price-PnL-unit hedge weights rather than standardized loading-only weights
persist point-in-time per-leg queue depth quote fee target size and receive-time origin
measure same-window joint fill bitmasks prospectively on refreshed public tape
estimate full-completion and each one-leg partial state directly rather than using min marginals
value every partial state with contemporaneous abort/unwind bid depth fees slippage latency and adverse markout
use chronological/block-bootstrap uncertainty and fail closed with insufficient independent completion windows
compare fill-conditioned pair PnL under 1x 1.5x and 2x executable-cost stress
only after the above compare broader universe shorter common sample lower z and higher FDR within the authorized PAPER envelope
